title: The Clockwork Cellar
intro: The town clock has begun striking thirteen. Its retired maker swears the trouble is coming from the workshop cellar, where no machine should still be running.
mapText: Map: Workshop descends to Cellar Landing; west is the Boiler Room, east is the Parts Store, and below waits the Heart Chamber.

workshop.name: The Abandoned Workshop
workshop.description: Stopped clocks cover every wall, though one second hand twitches whenever you look away.

cellar_landing.name: The Cellar Landing
cellar_landing.description: Copper pipes shiver beneath the floor and oily footprints split in three directions.

boiler_room.name: The Boiler Room
boiler_room.description: A brass furnace breathes red light through rows of riveted teeth.

parts_store.name: The Parts Store
parts_store.description: Drawers rattle by themselves beneath shelves of mismatched hands, gears, and glass eyes.

heart_chamber.name: The Heart Chamber
heart_chamber.description: A pendulum taller than a house swings above a machine that pulses like a metal heart.

iron_caretaker.name: iron caretaker
iron_caretaker.encounterText: The great machine opens a single furnace-bright eye and names you an unauthorized component.
iron_caretaker.victoryText: The caretaker falls silent. Far overhead, the town clock strikes twelve and finally stops.
